description: `status` is a language command (SPEC 7.1), but the default hosted harness runs no language command, so `prose status` exits 2 with `prose cli service triage`; nothing is forwarded.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: That command isn't quite right.
Detail: `status` is a language command, which runs only with a local harness; did you mean `prose cli service triage`? Nothing was forwarded or sent. To run the language command, select a local harness with `prose cli harness use <id>`
Action: Use `cli service triage`: `prose cli service triage`.
